sources.purpose: Sign in with Apple door for Prims Browsers

locked_behaviors: Apple callback remains a POST-compatible OAuth return; state-cookie SameSite behavior must survive migration.
Existing prims_session cookies remain verifiable during an intentional cutover window unless a separately planned rotation occurs.
login.prims.sh redirects successful users to browsers.prims.sh.
browsers.prims.sh rejects missing/invalid sessions and continues to route only configured containers.
Container machine-host authentication remains an independent Authentik gate; Hub/Foundation publisher identity is not substituted.
Secret values are never committed or copied into this migration record.
archive_gate: Both legacy test suites or equivalent imported contract tests pass from the consolidated repository.
Preview login and gateway use the shared session implementation.
Real Apple sign-in callback succeeds after migration.
Existing-session, logout, invalid-session and container-hop acceptance pass.
Production domains cut over with rollback instructions and prior Worker versions retained.
Old repositories contain successor notices and are archived only after real-use verification.
